description: App store v1 — feature catalogue + preferences (app-store-spec.md v0.4, Part 1). STATIC base: deployed with the server via the app's model.json, applied at boot by the FAP-LDP node (fap-ldp-spec §5). What is hot-injected (E11, model-injection-spec.md) concerns third-party features, not this base (L2).

app.features.comment: Catalogue (admin). Exposed IRI = slug (decision B2, slug→id lookup on the PEP side, CA-A7).

role_min.comment: minimum role to see/enable the feature (menu + guard filtering §1.4.1; security stays server-side ACL/PDP)

default_enabled.comment: also used if the key is missing from prefs (§1.9.4a)

app.prefs.comment: One LDP resource per user: /prefs/<user_id>, flattened jsonb column, atomic PATCH (decisions B1/B3). PATCH body form R1: {"prefs": {"<slug>": {…}}}.

rls.comment: owner-only; another user → row filtered out → PEP returns 404 (§1.9.10, CA-A2)

acl.subject: foaf:Agent
acl.comment: pod members (framework contract, org claim); externals stopped at step 1 of the PDP (published=false) — M2

triggers.name: on_user_insert_app_store
triggers.comment: default prefs from app.features.default_enabled + owner-webid ACL (read/write/control) on /prefs/<pk> + role:admin (§1.4.2, M2). SECURITY DEFINER because FORCE RLS filters even the owner.

triggers.name: on_feature_insert_app_store
triggers.comment: injects the default key into all existing prefs (§1.9.4b)

migrations_one_shot.comment: backfill prefs+ACL of users existing at deployment (§1.9.4c), idempotent, to run ONCE by hand (role admin)
backfill owner ACL on /users/<pk>/components/ for users existing at deployment (workstream 3 rev 9 F1.1), idempotent, to run ONCE by hand (role admin)

seed: app-specific — provided by the app in its model.json (suggested content: spec/app-store-catalogue.md). This package ships NO seed (app-store-spec §1.3).
